purpose: Service review for WUP2025 rank 618 Mérida (city code 7008); city-bound registry evidence and safe anonymous parcel-geometry route.
primaryPublisher: Ayuntamiento de Mérida, Dirección de Catastro Municipal
registryBasis: The Ayuntamiento de Mérida identifies a Dirección de Catastro Municipal, and its official Geoportal describes municipal cadastral information covering Mérida and its comisarías. The portal’s public guide describes searching and locating individual properties; no parcel-specific search or selection was used. The municipality and registry are city-bound, but no safe geometry-only response was verified.

officialSources.observation: Official Ayuntamiento directory identifies the Dirección de Catastro Municipal.

Official municipal Geoportal describes its spatial platform and municipal cadastral information including comisarías; its public guide describes property searches. The direct landing GET returned a Radware challenge page (HTTP 200), while the public web inspection returned 403; no challenge was solved or parcel searched.
Official municipal service catalogue includes cadastral procedures; no application, cadastral key, address or payment was submitted.

searchQueries.query: Mérida Yucatán Mexico official municipal cadastral map GIS property registry
searchQueries.scope: Find city-specific cadastral evidence and an anonymous geometry-only map service.
searchQueries.result: The official municipality lists its Dirección de Catastro Municipal and describes its Geoportal as a municipal spatial platform with cadastral information. Public guidance is property-search oriented; direct map landing was blocked by an anti-bot page and the separate map host returned 403. No user/property query or captcha interaction occurred.
searchQueries.executionMethod: Public English/local-language search and official-page review; no private lookup.

searchQueries.query: Catastro Municipal Mérida Yucatán geoportal predios mapa geográfico datos catastrales
searchQueries.scope: Verificar el Catastro municipal y revisar si existe un servicio público de geometría que no requiera consultar un predio.
searchQueries.result: El Ayuntamiento confirma la Dirección de Catastro Municipal y describe el Geoportal con información catastral municipal. La guía del portal ofrece búsquedas/localización de predios, sin exponer un esquema de geometría solamente. El acceso directo al mapa mostró una página de protección anti-bot/403; no se resolvió ni se envió formulario.
searchQueries.executionMethod: Public English/local-language search and official-page review; no private lookup.

accessReview.reason: A city public cadastral Geoportal exists, but the inspected guidance is property-oriented and the map host was blocked; no anonymous geometry-only schema or response was verified.
